body: ### Bug: Inconsistent import paths for custom serializers The `ferry_generator|graphql_builder` section uses incorrect import paths `package:diohub/lib/graphql/serializer/date.dart` which includes an erroneous `lib/` segment in the path. The correct path is `package:diohub/graphql/serializer/date.dart` as used in the `ferry_generator|serializer_builder` section below. Dart packages don't include `lib/` in the import path since it's implicit, so this will cause the code generator to produce code with invalid imports that fail to resolve.

Using <external-path ... path=\".\"/> grants the FileProvider access to the entire external storage root, which is overly broad and increases exposure if a content:// URI is leaked. Prefer a narrower path (e.g., <external-files-path> scoped to your app, or a specific subdirectory) and only expose what you actually need.
Using GitHub Actions from a moving ref (@master) is risky and can break builds or introduce supply-chain risk. Pin these actions to a tagged release or (preferably) a full commit SHA.

This contains a placeholder for the security contact email. Please replace it with a real contact address (or remove the email option) before merging so reporters have a working private channel.

Exposing `category` as `dynamic` makes this API easy to misuse and removes static guarantees for downstream consumers. Prefer a more constrained type (e.g., `Object?`, `String?`/`Symbol` for enum name, or a lightweight `LensCategory` value type defined in this package) so invalid category values are caught earlier.

Setting `required_inputs: [\".g.dart\"]` will prevent this builder from running unless a corresponding `.g.dart` exists, which is likely unintended for a tool-definition generator that should operate over regular Dart libraries. Remove `required_inputs` or change it to the actual prerequisite(s) you need so the builder executes for the intended targets.

The PR appears to vendor `extended_nested_scroll_view` twice: once under dependencies/extended_nested_scroll_view and again under dependencies/extended_nested_scroll_view/extended_nested_scroll_view-6.2.1 (with duplicated example/generated files). This duplication increases repo size and makes future updates/error-prone. Consider keeping a single copy (or a single submodule) and removing the duplicated versioned directory unless there’s a clear build-time requirement for both.
There’s trailing whitespace/empty line inside the class body. This can cause lint/formatting noise. Remove the extra whitespace line or run ktfmt/spotless formatting if enabled.

Raising `minSdkVersion` from 19 to 26 is a significant support drop (Android 8+ only). If this is not strictly required, consider using `flutter.minSdkVersion` or documenting the rationale (and ensuring Play Store/device support expectations align). If it is required (e.g., for specific plugins or desugaring constraints), please call it out in release notes/README to avoid surprises for maintainers and users.

**Bug:** `emptyBuilder` is ignored in `InfiniteScrollWrapper`, preventing custom empty state widgets from rendering in new organization views.
Severity: MEDIUM
Suggested Fix Update `_InfinitePaginationState` in `lib/common/wrappers/infinite_scroll_wrapper.dart` to check and invoke `widget.emptyBuilder` inside `noItemsFoundIndicatorBuilder` when provided.
Prompt for AI Agent ``` Review the code at the location below. A potential bug has been identified by an AI agent. Verify if this is a real issue. If it is, propose a fix; if not, explain why it's not valid. Location: lib/view/profile/organizations/user_organizations.dart#L34-L42 Potential issue: `InfiniteScrollWrapper` exposes `emptyBuilder` and passes it to `_InfinitePagination`, but `_InfinitePaginationState` does not consume `widget.emptyBuilder`. Instead, `noItemsFoundIndicatorBuilder` hardcodes a fallback text widget. Consequently, providing custom empty state widgets in `emptyBuilder` across the new organization views has no effect, rendering the default generic message instead of the intended custom states. ```
Also affects: - `lib/view/profile/organization/organization_members.dart:49~57` - `lib/view/home/widgets/organizations_tab.dart:34~34` Did we get this right? :+1: / :-1: to inform future reviews.

**Bug:** Missing `SliverOverlapInjector` causes content to be partially obscured under pinned headers in `OrganizationAboutScreen`.
Severity: LOW
Suggested Fix Replace the root `ListView` in `OrganizationAboutScreen` with a `CustomScrollView` that includes a `SliverOverlapInjector` corresponding to the handle from `NestedScrollView`.
Prompt for AI Agent ``` Review the code at the location below. A potential bug has been identified by an AI agent. Verify if this is a real issue. If it is, propose a fix; if not, explain why it's not valid. Location: lib/view/profile/organization/organization_about_screen.dart#L35-L37 Potential issue: `OrganizationAboutScreen` uses a standard `ListView` as the body of a `DynamicScroll` (`NestedScrollView`) whose header slivers are wrapped in a `SliverOverlapAbsorber`. Because `OrganizationAboutScreen` does not wrap its contents in a `CustomScrollView` with a `SliverOverlapInjector`, the top content of the Overview tab can be partially obscured beneath the pinned app bar and tab bar when the header collapses. ```
Did we get this right? :+1: / :-1: to inform future reviews.

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Connect the organization empty states to the pagination wrapper.** When a list returns no items, `InfiniteScrollWrapper` displays its generic “Nothing to see here” indicator. It never calls this `emptyBuilder`. The same failure hides the tailored empty states in `UserOrganizations` and `OrganizationMembers`. Update the wrapper’s no-items branch to call `widget.emptyBuilder` when supplied.
